notice: All organizations, inputs, activity and results are synthetic. This proposed workflow is not a connected employer system or measured company performance.
title: Turn AI-search interest into an evaluable business question.
intro: A proposed growth workbench for Petra Labs: develop evidence-labeled enterprise opportunities, connect educational content to consultations and scope useful service engagements.
queueIntro: An observed answer is a sample, not a complete view of AI search. Record the prompt scope, observation window and what the account team can actually infer.
workbenchIntro: Change the evidence and service prerequisites. Keep a sampled visibility issue, a buyer-confirmed need and a measured business outcome distinct.
firstBody: Pair a bounded AI-search observation with a CMO-level discovery question, an accountable buyer and a scoped evaluation. Explain what remains unmeasured.

fields.label: Prompt set, model and observation window recorded
Services scope and success criterion outlined

rules.title: Define the observation scope
rules.next: Record prompts, model, market and time window before comparing visibility or drawing conclusions.

rules.title: Collect a bounded observation
rules.next: Label the hypothesis and obtain a reproducible example before presenting it as a discovered issue.

rules.title: Separate correlation from impact
rules.next: A change in answer visibility does not by itself prove incremental traffic, pipeline or revenue.

rules.title: Identify the marketing decision owner
rules.next: Find who owns the business question and can evaluate an appropriate services engagement.

rules.title: Connect the observation to a business question
rules.next: An interesting answer sample needs a relevant buyer decision before it becomes a consultation.

rules.title: Outline the service evaluation
rules.next: Define a scoped engagement, useful measurement and explicit limitations. Do not treat a services engagement as a self-serve SaaS trial.

rules.title: Review delivery capacity
rules.next: Coordinate the proposed work with the delivery team before promising an engagement timeline.

ready.title: Ready for a scoped consultation
ready.next: A reviewer can connect the bounded observation to a buyer question and proposed services evaluation. The observation alone proves no commercial outcome.

metricsIntro: Compare a synthetic educational-content cohort with consultations and qualified services opportunities. Keep observed activity separate from inferred influence.

rows: A pattern in the defined sample
A stated contribution to the journey

metricsNotes: Use the same prompt set, model and observation window when describing a change.
Qualified service opportunities need a buyer, problem, scope and delivery path. Traffic alone is not services pipeline.
The invented spend figures exclude delivery costs and are not service prices, margins or promises of AI-search results.

experiments.name: Evidence-labeled educational brief
experiments.hypothesis: Clear limitations make a research-led consultation more credible.
experiments.treatment: Bounded example, evidence and buyer question
experiments.allocation: Use matched account cohorts and a fixed observation window. Review uncertainty and selection effects before expansion.

experiments.name: Services readiness before proposal
experiments.hypothesis: A shared scope and delivery check reduce ambiguous proposals.
experiments.treatment: Buyer question, scope, measurement and capacity
experiments.primary: Proposals with an accepted evaluation plan
experiments.allocation: Use matched account cohorts and a fixed observation window. Review uncertainty and selection effects before expansion.

roadmap.title: Learn the services buyer
roadmap.body: Study founder-led discovery, buyer questions and delivery requirements. Define a reproducible research brief.
roadmap.measure: Accepted buyer questions and source coverage

roadmap.title: Connect education to consultation
roadmap.body: Test an evidence-labeled asset with a bounded account cohort and measure held consultations.

roadmap.title: Build a repeatable growth system
roadmap.body: Automate the useful research and handoff steps while preserving review, delivery capacity and measurement limits.
roadmap.measure: Qualified services pipeline and accepted scope
